name: com.hodlodds/hodlodds-mcp
description: Local crash-odds tools with free market discovery and bounded x402 USDC payments on Solana or Base.

environmentVariables.name: HODLODDS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: HodlOdds HTTPS API or loopback test API

environmentVariables.name: HODLODDS_PAY_TO
environmentVariables.description: Verified recipient; required on mainnet and for keyed test-network use

environmentVariables.name: HODLODDS_KEYPAIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute local key-file path; omission enables read-only mode

environmentVariables.name: HODLODDS_SESSION_BUDGET_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Process USDC budget; required when a key is set; resets on restart
